description: Permissions for the app's own webview. Scoped by webview label rather than window label: browser tabs are child webviews of the same window, and scoping by window would hand every capability below to whatever page the user loads. (`local: true` already excludes remote origins, but relying on that alone would break the moment a browser tab pointed at a local dev server.) The `core:webview:*` grants are deliberately absent: browser-tab webviews are built and driven by `src-tauri/src/browser`, so no JavaScript in this app needs to create, move or close a webview through the core plugin.
